The '''Denusia system''' was located within the [[Trailing Sectors/Legends|Trailing Sectors]] portion of the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]].<ref name="TEA" /> The [[Star system/Legends|system]] was home to the [[Species/Legends|creature]] known as the [[Denusian squirmer]].<ref name="FF128" /><ref name="Planetnamia" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Denusia system was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the system in grid square M-13.<ref name="TEA" />
